meta.note: Synthetic runs of the simulator, same seed with and without each link. Educational comparison, not a prediction. "People still there when the fire front or embers arrived" counts synthetic people at home at that moment; it is not a casualty count.

measures.fireFrontHome: synthetic people of the area still at home when the fire front reached their street
measures.vehFireFront: area vehicles on a street when the fire front reached it
measures.vehEmber: area vehicles on a street under embers
measures.vehNoRoute: area vehicles on the road at the end with no route to safety (cut off)
measures.vehNotOut: area vehicles that set off but never left the area
measures.clearP90: minutes from the first order until 90% of the area's evacuating vehicles had left the area (Time Study §10.4 measure: beyond Panoramic Way or Dwight Way); null if not reached
